outputs.preview: Implemented WCAG keyboard operability, conditional ARIA role sanitization, and focus-visible indicators

findings.observation: Finding 1: (1) In EdgeBadgeOverlay.tsx, resolveEdgeDisplayText fails to cleanly sanitize compound/nested cycle prefixes such as 'CYCLE: (Repair Task #1)', leaving unbalanced opening parentheses; (2) In EdgeMarkerDefs.tsx and GraphEdge/index.tsx, arrowhead marker paths have hardcoded fill colors instead of dynamic harmonization with sourceAccentColor/context-stroke, causing a visual disconnect between dynamic stroke colors and arrowhead tips.
findings.remediation: 1. Refactor resolveEdgeDisplayText in EdgeBadgeOverlay.tsx to robustly clean compound prefixes (e.g. 'CYCLE:', 'CYCLE -', 'CYCLE (..)') without leaving stray unbalanced parentheses or punctuation; add comprehensive unit test cases in EdgeBadgeOverlay.test.tsx. 2. Update EdgeMarkerDefs.tsx and GraphEdge styling/defs to ensure arrowhead markers harmonize dynamically with sourceAccentColor and selection stroke colors (e.g. using fill='context-stroke' or CSS variable marker fills) with accompanying tests.

findings.observation: Finding 2: (1) In GraphEdge/index.tsx, the isHovered prop is accepted in GraphEdgeProps and checked in areGraphEdgePropsEqual, but is never applied to the <g> or <path> element class lists (missing is-hovered class), preventing programmatic hover state triggered from external canvas or telemetry drawer events from rendering hover styles; (2) In EdgeBadgeOverlay.tsx and EdgeBadgeOverlay.css, .edge-badge-inner and .edge-badge-label lack min-width: 0 and flex-shrink: 1 inside the flex layout, and computedWidth lacks upper-bound clamping (MAX_BADGE_WIDTH), causing text-overflow: ellipsis to fail and allowing long edge labels to expand unboundedly across the graph canvas.
findings.remediation: 1. In GraphEdge/index.tsx, append isHovered ? 'is-hovered' : '' to the className strings of both the outer <g> container and the inner <path> graph-edge-path, and update GraphEdge.css to ensure .graph-edge-group.is-hovered and .graph-edge-path.is-hovered properly activate hover stroke width (2.5px) and accent styling without requiring raw mouse hover. 2. In EdgeBadgeOverlay.tsx, clamp computedWidth with a defined upper bound (e.g. MAX_BADGE_WIDTH = 280) and in EdgeBadgeOverlay.css ensure .edge-badge-inner and .edge-badge-label have min-width: 0, flex-shrink: 1, and text-overflow: ellipsis to guarantee long text cleanly truncates without blowing out SVG foreignObject dimensions. 3. Add unit test coverage in GraphEdge.test.tsx and EdgeBadgeOverlay.test.tsx to verify programmatic isHovered styling and max width label truncation.

findings.observation: Finding 3: (1) In GraphEdge/index.tsx, interactive edges with onClick lack accessibility attributes and keyboard handlers (missing role="button", tabIndex={0}, aria-label, and onKeyDown for Enter/Space activation); (2) In EdgeBadgeOverlay.tsx, role="button" and tabIndex={0} are applied unconditionally even for non-interactive static badges; (3) In GraphEdge.css and EdgeBadgeOverlay.css, :focus-visible focus indicator styling is missing on focused groups.
findings.remediation: 1. In GraphEdge/index.tsx, attach role="button", tabIndex={0}, aria-label, and onKeyDown handler (Enter/Space activation) when onClick is provided. 2. In EdgeBadgeOverlay.tsx, conditionally assign role="button" and tabIndex={0} only when Boolean(onClick || badge?.clickable) is true. 3. In GraphEdge.css and EdgeBadgeOverlay.css, add .graph-edge-group:focus-visible and .edge-badge-group:focus-visible rules with outline styling. 4. Add unit test coverage in GraphEdge.test.tsx and EdgeBadgeOverlay.test.tsx for keyboard activation and dynamic ARIA/tabIndex attributes.

nodes.name: Origin (0,0) Ghost Text & Top Banner Purging
nodes.description: Enforced strict Number.isFinite coordinate validation across all badge placement resolution pathways

outputs.label: Enforced strict Number.isFinite coordinate validation across all badge placement resolution pathways
outputs.preview: Enforced strict Number.isFinite coordinate validation across all badge placement resolution pathways

findings.observation: Finding 1: False-positive badge suppression on valid origin-crossing polylines and unhardened ghost fallback in standalone GraphEdge component
findings.remediation: 1. Centralize resolveSafeBadgePlacement in src/primitives/edges/GraphEdge/collision.ts as the single source of truth for both GraphBadgeLayer and GraphEdge. 2. Fix false-positive suppression: When edge.points has valid non-zero total path length (totalLength > 0), allow computed midpoint (0,0) instead of suppressing it. 3. Update GraphEdge/index.tsx to use resolveSafeBadgePlacement and suppress EdgeBadgeOverlay when placement is null. 4. Add unit test coverage in GraphBadgeLayer.test.tsx and collision.test.ts for valid origin-crossing polylines and standalone GraphEdge suppression.

findings.observation: Finding 2: Coordinate translation mismatch in EdgeBadgeOverlay leader lines causes double displacement, and unvalidated origin badgeRect bypasses ghost suppression
findings.remediation: 1. In src/primitives/edges/GraphEdge/EdgeBadgeOverlay.tsx, translate leaderPoints and anchorPoint to local badge coordinates (relative to renderX, renderY) so leader lines render correctly from (anchor.x - renderX, anchor.y - renderY) to (0, 0) instead of projecting into double-translated canvas space. 2. In src/primitives/edges/GraphEdge/collision.ts, harden resolveSafeBadgePlacement so that default origin bounding boxes (x=0, y=0) on unpositioned edges without valid anchorPoint or non-zero polyline points do not bypass ghost suppression. 3. Add test coverage in GraphBadgeLayer.test.tsx and GraphEdge tests verifying relative leader line coordinates and unpositioned origin badgeRect suppression.

findings.observation: Finding 3: Non-finite coordinate penetration (NaN / Infinity) in resolveSafeBadgePlacement, computePolylineMidpoint, and synthetic edge fallbacks bypasses ghost suppression and generates invalid SVG transforms
findings.remediation: 1. In src/primitives/edges/GraphEdge/collision.ts, harden resolveSafeBadgePlacement, computePolylineLength, and computePolylineMidpoint to require Number.isFinite on all coordinates (labelX, labelY, badgeRect dimensions/positions, and polyline point coordinates), returning null / 0 when non-finite. 2. In src/primitives/edges/GraphEdge/index.tsx, guard synthetic source/target midpoint computation with Number.isFinite. 3. Expand test coverage in GraphBadgeLayer.test.tsx and collision.test.ts to verify strict suppression and clean unmounting for NaN/Infinity coordinates.

nodes.name: Rich Harness Telemetry & Summary Collectors
nodes.description: Elevated top-level costUsd on node metrics, enforced strict 5-part token summation, and propagated timeline telemetry

outputs.label: Elevated top-level costUsd on node metrics, enforced strict 5-part token summation, and propagated timeline telemetry
outputs.preview: Elevated top-level costUsd on node metrics, enforced strict 5-part token summation, and propagated timeline telemetry

findings.observation: Finding 1: Multi-round timestamp capture in extractTaskTimestamps calculates inflated validation duration by pairing initial valStart with terminal review across multi-round repair cycles, distorting gate cognitive latency; additionally costUsd is dropped in computeTaskTokens when hostTokens is estimated.
findings.remediation: 1. Update extractTaskTimestamps and computeGateTiming in metrics-collector.ts to calculate per-round validation intervals or compute validation duration from the latest validation cycle/commands, preventing implementer repair time from leaking into gate cognitive latency. 2. Preserve costUsd in computeTaskTokens when hostTokens is present even when isEstimated is true. 3. Ensure test suite tests/unit/summary covers multi-round timing calculations.

findings.observation: Finding 2: Gate node status incorrectly degrades to 'pending' on changes_requested due to cleared validation lease; gate node metadata omits validator attribution, repair rounds, and validation history; and rollup metrics edge traffic ignores dependency edges.
findings.remediation: 1. Update gateNode status mapping in graph-generator-helpers.ts so that task.status === 'changes_requested' maps to 'warning' and failed/cancelled tasks map to 'error' rather than falling back to 'pending'. 2. Enrich gateNode.metadata with validator_id (resolved from task.validation?.validator_id or latest validation_history entry), repairRounds (task.repair_round ?? 0), validationHistory (task.validation_history ?? []), and writeScope. 3. Update computeGateTokens in metrics-collector.ts to accept optional hostTokens (preserving reasoningTokens, cache tokens, and costUsd). 4. In collectMetrics (metrics-collector.ts), calculate totalEdgeTrafficExchanges and totalEdgeTrafficTokens accounting for task.dependencies count and join edges. 5. Expand unit tests in tests/unit/summary/ to verify gate node status on changes_requested, gate metadata fields, and dependency edge counts.

findings.observation: Finding 3: Node metrics omit top-level costUsd elevation from token details on worker and gate nodes; computeTaskTokens and computeGateTokens must guarantee totalTokens strictly adheres to the 5-part summation formula (Input + Output + Reasoning + CacheCreation + CacheRead); and timeline-collector omits token/cost/duration telemetry propagation from event payloads.
findings.remediation: 1. In graph-generator-helpers.ts, elevate costUsd to node.metrics.costUsd on both taskNode and gateNode when available in taskTokens.costUsd or gateTokens.costUsd. 2. In metrics-collector.ts (computeTaskTokens and computeGateTokens), ensure totalTokens strictly evaluates to inputTokens + outputTokens + (reasoningTokens ?? 0) + (cacheCreationTokens ?? 0) + (cacheReadTokens ?? 0) across all execution paths. 3. In types.ts and timeline-collector.ts, support optional telemetry fields (tokens, cost_usd, duration_ms) on TimelineEventRecord when present in event payloads. 4. Add comprehensive unit tests in tests/unit/summary/ verifying top-level node metrics costUsd, token 5-part formula consistency, and timeline event telemetry propagation.

nodes.name: Node Detail Drawer Tabs & High-DPI Lightbox
nodes.description: Implemented broken image fallback states, standardized drawer-empty-state styles, and hardened streamUtils formatters

outputs.label: Implemented broken image fallback states, standardized drawer-empty-state styles, and hardened streamUtils formatters
outputs.preview: Implemented broken image fallback states, standardized drawer-empty-state styles, and hardened streamUtils formatters

findings.observation: Adversarial Gauntlet Round 1: LightboxDialog lacks keyboard focus trapping and focus restoration on dismiss; copy buttons in IoStreamItem and CommandsTab lack robust fallback in restricted/headless execution environments.
findings.remediation: 1. Implement keyboard focus trapping (Tab / Shift+Tab cycling within dialog) and focus restoration to the previously active element when dismissed in LightboxDialog.tsx. 2. Harden copy interactions in IoStreamItem.tsx and CommandsTab.tsx with textarea/execCommand fallback when navigator.clipboard is unavailable or fails. 3. Add unit and component tests covering focus management in LightboxDialog and clipboard fallback resilience.

findings.observation: Adversarial Gauntlet Round 2: Lightbox zoom buttons lack disabled/aria-disabled boundary gating at zoom limits (100% and 400%) and Reset Zoom button remains active when already at default scale/zero pan; CSS disabled styling for lightbox action buttons is missing; interactive pan dragging lacks coordinate clamping to prevent unbounded off-screen panning.
findings.remediation: 1. In LightboxDialog.tsx, add boundary gating with disabled and aria-disabled attributes on Zoom In (zoom >= 4), Zoom Out (zoom <= 1), and Reset Zoom (zoom === 1 && panOffset.x === 0 && panOffset.y === 0). 2. In NodeDetailDrawerTabs.css, add .drawer-lightbox-action-btn:disabled and [aria-disabled='true'] styling with reduced opacity, cursor not-allowed, and pointer-events none. 3. In LightboxDialog.tsx, clamp panOffset in handleMouseMove to bounded viewport limits based on current zoom scale. 4. In NodeDetailDrawer.test.tsx, add test assertions verifying button disabled states at 100% and 400% zoom levels and reset state.

findings.observation: Adversarial Gauntlet Round 3: LightboxDialog and AssetsTab lack image load error (onError) fallback handling when asset URLs fail or are unreachable; empty state placeholders across tabs (CommandsTab, FilesTab, FindingsTab, IoTab) use disparate ad-hoc inline styles instead of standardized .drawer-empty-state styling; formatBytes in streamUtils.ts does not guard against non-finite values (Infinity/NaN).
findings.remediation: 1. In LightboxDialog.tsx and AssetsTab.tsx, add image loading error state handling (onError handler rendering a fallback error banner/icon when asset image fails to load). 2. Standardize empty state presentations in CommandsTab.tsx, FilesTab.tsx, FindingsTab.tsx, and IoTab.tsx using the unified .drawer-empty-state class. 3. Harden formatBytes in streamUtils.ts to check !Number.isFinite(bytes) returning '0 B'. 4. Update NodeDetailDrawer.test.tsx with test cases covering image error fallback and standardized empty states.

nodes.name: Playwright Visual Audit & Graph Dataset Verification
nodes.description: Implemented live parameterized descender glyph clipping tests across 7 edge kinds and screenshot evidence markdown report export

outputs.label: Implemented live parameterized descender glyph clipping tests across 7 edge kinds and screenshot evidence markdown report export
outputs.preview: Implemented live parameterized descender glyph clipping tests across 7 edge kinds and screenshot evidence markdown report export

findings.observation: Finding 1: Edge badge visual audit in graphVisualAudit.spec.ts relies on negative string matching rather than regex-based positive coordinate verification, and screenshot-ingestion.ts contains a token-splitting bug for compound viewport identifiers like wide-desktop.
findings.remediation: 1. Update graphVisualAudit.spec.ts to extract badge transform translations with regex (/transform="translate\(\s*([\d.]+)(?:px)?,\s*([\d.]+)(?:px)?\)"/g) and assert that all rendered edge badges have strictly positive, finite (x > 0, y > 0) coordinates matching edge badgeRects. 2. Refactor scripts/screenshot-ingestion.ts to accurately parse compound viewport names (e.g. wide-desktop) by matching known viewport prefix tokens before splitting archetype and tab identifiers.

findings.observation: Finding 2: Multi-viewport visual audit tests in tests/visual/node-drawer-visual-audit.spec.ts and tests/visual/graphVisualAudit.spec.ts lack assertions for mobile slide-over viewport containment (verifying that at 375px mobile viewport width the drawer layout prevents horizontal overflow and maintains 100% containment) and omit drawer interactive dismissal verification (Escape keydown and close button click resetting selectedNodeId) across the responsive viewport matrix (mobile 375px, tablet 768px, desktop 1280px).
findings.remediation: 1. Update tests/visual/node-drawer-visual-audit.spec.ts and tests/visual/graphVisualAudit.spec.ts with explicit assertions verifying responsive drawer containment across mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1280px/1920px), asserting that mobile drawer width does not exceed the 375px viewport boundary. 2. Add comprehensive test cases in tests/visual/node-drawer-visual-audit.spec.ts verifying NodeDetailDrawer dismissal interactions via close button click and Escape keydown event dispatch. 3. Ensure NodeDetailDrawer.css has responsive rules (@media (max-width: 640px) { .node-drawer { min-width: 0; width: 100%; max-width: 100%; } }) for seamless mobile viewport adaptation.

findings.observation: Finding 3: Descender glyph clipping audit across all 7 semantic edge kinds is not verified against rendered DOM/SVG badge structures, and screenshot-ingestion.ts lacks Markdown summary report generation for capsule evidence.
findings.remediation: 1. In tests/visual/graphVisualAudit.spec.ts, replace the mock static style check with a parameterized test rendering edge badges across all 7 semantic edge kinds (spawn, sequence, data, dependency, loop, gate, critic) with labels containing descenders (e.g. 'dependency packaging', 'quality gate', 'loop payload query', 'dispatch staging', 'telemetry signing'), asserting container heights >= 26px and line-height >= 1.2. 2. In scripts/screenshot-ingestion.ts, add  and  to produce formatted Markdown tables and carousel evidence for capsule reporting. 3. Add corresponding test coverage in scripts/screenshot-ingestion.test.ts and verify bun test v1.3.14 (0d9b296a) passes cleanly.

Update graphVisualAudit.spec.ts to extract badge transform translations with regex (/transform="translate\(\s*([\d.]+)(?:px)?,\s*([\d.]+)(?:px)?\)"/g) and assert that all rendered edge badges have strictly positive, finite (x > 0, y > 0) coordinates matching edge badgeRects. 2. Refactor scripts/screenshot-ingestion.ts to accurately parse compound viewport names (e.g. wide-desktop) by matching known viewport prefix tokens before splitting archetype and tab identifiers.

findings.observation: Finding 2: Multi-viewport visual audit tests in tests/visual/node-drawer-visual-audit.spec.ts and tests/visual/graphVisualAudit.spec.ts lack assertions for mobile slide-over viewport containment (verifying that at 375px mobile viewport width the drawer layout prevents horizontal overflow and maintains 100% containment) and omit drawer interactive dismissal verification (Escape keydown and close button click resetting selectedNodeId) across the responsive viewport matrix (mobile 375px, tablet 768px, desktop 1280px).
findings.remediation: 1. Update tests/visual/node-drawer-visual-audit.spec.ts and tests/visual/graphVisualAudit.spec.ts with explicit assertions verifying responsive drawer containment across mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1280px/1920px), asserting that mobile drawer width does not exceed the 375px viewport boundary. 2. Add comprehensive test cases in tests/visual/node-drawer-visual-audit.spec.ts verifying NodeDetailDrawer dismissal interactions via close button click and Escape keydown event dispatch. 3. Ensure NodeDetailDrawer.css has responsive rules (@media (max-width: 640px) { .node-drawer { min-width: 0; width: 100%; max-width: 100%; } }) for seamless mobile viewport adaptation.

findings.observation: Finding 3: Descender glyph clipping audit across all 7 semantic edge kinds is not verified against rendered DOM/SVG badge structures, and screenshot-ingestion.ts lacks Markdown summary report generation for capsule evidence.
findings.remediation: 1. In tests/visual/graphVisualAudit.spec.ts, replace the mock static style check with a parameterized test rendering edge badges across all 7 semantic edge kinds (spawn, sequence, data, dependency, loop, gate, critic) with labels containing descenders (e.g. 'dependency packaging', 'quality gate', 'loop payload query', 'dispatch staging', 'telemetry signing'), asserting container heights >= 26px and line-height >= 1.2. 2. In scripts/screenshot-ingestion.ts, add  and  to produce formatted Markdown tables and carousel evidence for capsule reporting. 3. Add corresponding test coverage in scripts/screenshot-ingestion.test.ts and verify bun test v1.3.14 (0d9b296a) passes cleanly.

exchanges.summary: Pushback Finding: Finding 1: Edge badge visual audit in graphVisualAudit.spec.ts relies on negative string matching rather than regex-based positive coordinate verification, and screenshot-ingestion.ts contains a token-splitting bug for compound viewport identifiers like wide-desktop.
exchanges.payloadSnippet: 1. Update graphVisualAudit.spec.ts to extract badge transform translations with regex (/transform="translate\(\s*([\d.]+)(?:px)?,\s*([\d.]+)(?:px)?\)"/g) and assert that all rendered edge badges have strictly positive, finite (x > 0, y > 0) coordinates matching edge badgeRects. 2. Refactor scripts/screenshot-ingestion.ts to accurately parse compound viewport names (e.g. wide-desktop) by matching known viewport prefix tokens before splitting archetype and tab identifiers.

exchanges.summary: Pushback Finding: Finding 2: Multi-viewport visual audit tests in tests/visual/node-drawer-visual-audit.spec.ts and tests/visual/graphVisualAudit.spec.ts lack assertions for mobile slide-over viewport containment (verifying that at 375px mobile viewport width the drawer layout prevents horizontal overflow and maintains 100% containment) and omit drawer interactive dismissal verification (Escape keydown and close button click resetting selectedNodeId) across the responsive viewport matrix (mobile 375px, tablet 768px, desktop 1280px).
exchanges.payloadSnippet: 1. Update tests/visual/node-drawer-visual-audit.spec.ts and tests/visual/graphVisualAudit.spec.ts with explicit assertions verifying responsive drawer containment across mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1280px/1920px), asserting that mobile drawer width does not exceed the 375px viewport boundary. 2. Add comprehensive test cases in tests/visual/node-drawer-visual-audit.spec.ts verifying NodeDetailDrawer dismissal interactions via close button click and Escape keydown event dispatch. 3. Ensure NodeDetailDrawer.css has responsive rules (@media (max-width: 640px) { .node-drawer { min-width: 0; width: 100%; max-width: 100%; } }) for seamless mobile viewport adaptation.

exchanges.summary: Pushback Finding: Finding 3: Descender glyph clipping audit across all 7 semantic edge kinds is not verified against rendered DOM/SVG badge structures, and screenshot-ingestion.ts lacks Markdown summary report generation for capsule evidence.

In scripts/screenshot-ingestion.ts, add  and  to produce formatted Markdown tables and carousel evidence for capsule reporting. 3. Add corresponding test coverage in scripts/screenshot-ingestion.test.ts and verify bun test v1.3.14 (0d9b296a) passes cleanly.
